## Summary

Describe the client-side change and link the board item from `docs/PROJECT_BOARD.md`.

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test or CI

## Verification

- [ ] `bun run lint`
- [ ] `bunx tsc --noEmit`
- [ ] `bun run test`
- [ ] `bun run build`
- [ ] `bun run test:e2e` when UI or navigation changed

## Checklist

- [ ] Client validation mirrors the server contract
- [ ] Loading, empty and error states are handled
- [ ] TanStack Query keys are invalidated after mutations
- [ ] Route is role-gated when required
- [ ] Documentation updated when behavior changed
